---
name: Device support
about: Request or contribute verification for a STREONOR device
---

## Device and environment

- Device model
- Operating system
- STREONOR app version
- STREONOR MCP version or commit, if tested

## What can you verify?

Describe the controls or workflows you want supported. If you tested a disposable scene, say which operations succeeded and what you observed on the device.

Use sanitized fixtures or redacted excerpts. Keep personal profiles, serial numbers, and app logs private.
